title: Module 1 · Juan’s method
sub: From Juan’s training session on Oct 19, 2026
src: Meeting started 2026/10/19 14:07 PDT - Notes by Gemini (Juan’s Drive)

pts: Making outbound calls right away is not the goal.
The goal is to learn a skill you can repeat: handling after-hours calls using AI.
Getting through technical and conversation roadblocks with AI is a core skill for handling calls.
from: the goal was not about making outbound calls immediately, but rather learning a replicable skill to handle after-hours calls using AI
navigating through technical and conversational roadblocks using AI represents a core competency for future call management

sections.h: Master one skill at a time (the basketball method)
pts: Learn like a beginner basketball player. Master one skill, then move to the next. Don’t advance before you’re ready.
Think of Steph Curry shooting three-pointers: repetition, correction, and teaching yourself.
Don’t rush into live calls.
from: Juan outlined a step-by-step training method where reps master single skills sequentially.
a basketball-inspired training model comparing skill acquisition to Steph Curry shooting three-pointers, emphasizing repetition, correction, and self-education over rushing into live calls
must master skills sequentially like a beginner basketball player rather than advancing prematurely

pts: Use AI to practice hard seller objections before you face them on a real call.
Make your practice scenarios realistic.
Use AI to troubleshoot technical problems too.
from: Juan demonstrated using AI to troubleshoot technical issues and practice complex seller objections.
emphasizing the creation of realistic practice scenarios

sections.h: Research every inbound lead with AI before you respond
pts: Get the caller’s name and the property address.
Put the details into your web browser.
Ask more than one AI tool: ChatGPT, Grok and Claude.
Then respond to the seller.
from: the inbound lead process requiring property research using AI before making calls
requiring staff to first obtain the caller's name and address, input the details into a web browser, and query multiple AI tools including ChatGPT, Grock [Grok], and Claude
Staff must gather caller details and query multiple AI tools before responding.

sections.h: Never claim to know property details you found online
pts: Say where the information came from. Example: “According to Redfin…”
Never talk as if you know the property yourself.
Naming the source keeps you from sounding robotic.
from: agents must attribute online property details to external sources rather than claiming direct knowledge
frame online information using phrases like "according to Redfin" to avoid sounding robotic

sections.h: Use AI as a guide, not a script
pts: Treat AI as a guide for the conversation.
Don’t read rigid scripts.
from: Juan emphasized treating AI as a conversational guide rather than reading rigid scripts.

pts: Never give a property price over the phone.
It doesn’t work. Every property needs a physical inspection first.
from: the strict policy against providing property prices over the phone
giving prices over the phone is ineffective because properties require physical inspection

sections.h: Cash buyer or agent? Tell the truth.
pts: A cash buyer is a fit when the house needs major repairs.
If the seller has no financial pressure, recommend listing with an agent.
from: Juan Diaz responded that cash buyers suit major repair needs
cash buyers should recommend listing with an agent if clients face no financial constraints

sections.h: How Juan answered the homeowner in the roleplay
sections.intro: Juan practiced the call with an AI playing a homeowner. These are the points he used.
pts: Twin Home Buyer has been in business for over 25 years.
We don’t pressure anyone.
We offer a free property inspection.
Next step: a 15-minute appointment with Juan, a licensed contractor.
The title transfer goes through a title company, like WFG Title.
Wholesaling happens occasionally.
from: Twin Home Buyer, has been in business for over 25 years, does not pressure clients, and offers complimentary property inspections

scheduling a 15-minute appointment with Juan Diaz (a licensed contractor), and discussing title transfer procedures using title companies like WFG title, while noting that wholesaling occurs occasionally

quiz.q: What is this training for first?
o: Making outbound calls right away
Learning a skill you can repeat: handling after-hours calls using AI
Learning to read a script word for word
quiz.why: Making outbound calls right away is not the goal. First you learn a skill you can repeat: handling after-hours calls using AI.

quiz.q: How do you learn the skills in Juan’s basketball method?
o: Master one skill at a time. Don’t advance before you’re ready.
Learn everything at once, then go live
Skip practice and learn on live calls
quiz.why: Like a beginner basketball player: master one skill at a time, with repetition and correction. Don’t rush into live calls.

quiz.q: How do you get ready for hard seller objections?
o: Wait until a real seller raises one
Read the objection list once
Practice them with AI in realistic scenarios
quiz.why: Juan uses AI to practice complex seller objections, and the practice scenarios should be realistic.

quiz.q: An inbound web lead calls. What do you do before you respond?
o: Call back right away and figure it out on the call
Get their name and address, put it in your browser, and ask more than one AI (ChatGPT, Grok, Claude)
Check one website and go
quiz.why: Name and address first, then the browser, then more than one AI tool. Then you respond.

quiz.q: You found the bedroom count on Redfin. How do you say it to the seller?
o: “Your house has 3 bedrooms.”
“I know your house has 3 bedrooms.”
“According to Redfin, it has 3 bedrooms.”
quiz.why: Always say where you found it. Never claim to know property details you found online. It also keeps you from sounding robotic.

quiz.q: How do you use AI during a seller conversation?
o: As a guide for the conversation
Read its answers word for word, like a script
Don’t use AI at all
quiz.why: Use AI as a guide, not a script. Don’t read rigid scripts.

quiz.q: On the phone, a seller asks, “What will you pay for my house?” What do you do?
o: Give them a price from an online estimate
Don’t give a price over the phone. The property needs a physical inspection first.
Guess a number to keep them interested
quiz.why: No prices over the phone. It doesn’t work, because every property needs a physical inspection.

quiz.q: The seller has no financial pressure. What do we recommend?
o: Sell to us for cash anyway
List with an agent
Wait a year and call us back
quiz.why: If the seller has no financial constraints, recommend listing with an agent. A cash buyer fits when the house needs major repairs.

quiz.q: In the roleplay, what next step did Juan set with the homeowner?
o: A 15-minute appointment with Juan, a licensed contractor
A price sent by text
A list of repairs for the seller to fix first
quiz.why: Juan set a 15-minute appointment. Juan is a licensed contractor, and the property inspection is free.
